'''2011 Bespin Regionals Mark Walseth LS Yavin 4''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4|Premiere-L-yavin4.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Walseth
* '''Deck name:''' Yavin 4 Space
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
